summary: Replaced npm fetch with Asana CSV parser for firewall-dashboard
details:
Added scripts/parse-asana-csv.js (quoted-field CSV parse, flexible Asana column names, maps to FirewallTask for the React app). Updated package.json fetch script, simplified .env.example to ASANA_CSV_PATH only, added data/.gitkeep and data/*.csv to .gitignore. Kept asana-oauth-setup.js and fetch-asana.js unchanged.

Usage: export CSV to data/asana-export.csv, run npm run fetch.
